keyEvents.text: Goal! Sparta Prague 1, AZ 0. Jonatan Braut Brunes (Sparta Prague) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by John Mercado with a cross.
Goal! Sparta Prague 2, AZ 0. Patrik Vydra (Sparta Prague) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jonatan Braut Brunes.
Josimar Alcócer (Sparta Prague) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Sparta Prague 2, AZ 0.
Second Half begins Sparta Prague 2, AZ 0.
Goal! Sparta Prague 2, AZ 1. Peer Koopmeiners (AZ) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Wassim Bouziane.
Substitution, AZ. Dave Kwakman replaces Wouter Goes.
Substitution, AZ. Ro-Zangelo Daal replaces Wassim Bouziane.
Substitution, AZ. Ayoub Oufkir replaces Valdemar Byskov.
Peer Koopmeiners (AZ) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sparta Prague. Ebrima Singhateh replaces Josimar Alcócer.
Ayoub Oufkir (AZ) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Sparta Prague 2, AZ 2. Ro-Zangelo Daal (AZ) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Dave Kwakman.
Substitution, Sparta Prague. Roman Macek replaces Andy Irving.
Substitution, Sparta Prague. Matej Jurásek replaces Jonatan Braut Brunes.
Goal! Sparta Prague 2, AZ 3. Ayoub Oufkir (AZ) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ro-Zangelo Daal.
Substitution, AZ. Seiya Maikuma replaces Denso Kasius.
Goal! Sparta Prague 2, AZ 4. Ayoub Oufkir (AZ) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Calvin Stengs following a fast break.
